# Vendored sources

Unmodified release trees, built by the top-level `Makefile`.

| Directory | Release | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bdwgc/` | Boehm–Demers–Weiser collector 8.2.12 | <https://github.com/ivmai/bdwgc/releases/download/v8.2.12/gc-8.2.12.tar.gz> | MIT-style, in `bdwgc/README.QUICK` |
| `qbe/` | QBE 1.3 | <https://c9x.me/compile/release/qbe-1.3.tar.xz> | MIT, in `qbe/LICENSE` |

To update one, replace its directory with the new release tree and update this table.
